children: DNA regained compliance with Nasdaq's $2.5M stockholders' equity requirement.
Nasdaq Panel determined DNA is back in compliance with Listing Rule 5550(b)(1) as of Aug 28, 2026.
Securities remain subject to delisting if DNA fails to maintain compliance with all Nasdaq rules through Nov 18, 2026.
Under Rule 5815(d)(4)(B), DNA will be under a mandatory panel monitor until Aug 28, 2027.
If out of compliance during monitoring, Nasdaq Staff will issue a delisting determination without allowing a cure period.
